title: Observed conversion is not a decision
method: Synthetic fixed-horizon experiment: 500/10,000 versus 550/10,000 conversions. Difference 0.5 percentage points; relative lift 10%. Independent-Bernoulli standard error ≈0.315 percentage points, giving an approximate 95% interval of −0.12 to +1.12 points for the difference. No win is established.
alt: Observed conversion is not a decision. Control: 5 percent; Treatment: 5.5 percent. Illustrative values.
